title: LingBot-Map Real-time Streaming 3D Scene Reconstruction
summary: LingBot-Map is a 3D foundation model designed for real-time, streaming 3D reconstruction from standard RGB video sequences. It utilizes a Geometric Context Transformer (GCT) architecture to handle coordinate grounding and long-range drift correction for embodied AI applications.
research_notes: Achieved state-of-the-art results on Oxford Spires and ETH3D benchmarks at launch, outperforming both streaming and offline methods.

evolution.summary: Launched by Ant Group's Robbyant division in mid-April 2026. Rapidly updated with FlashInfer KV cache optimizations for long sequences and hardware acceleration enabling 20 FPS real-time performance. A 25,000-frame indoor walkthrough demo was released in late April to demonstrate long-term stability.
